name: get_weather
description: Fetch current weather conditions and forecast data. Defaults to the user's current location if no city is specified.

inputs.name: city
inputs.description: City name to look up. Defaults to user's current location.

inputs.name: forecast_type
inputs.description: Type of forecast: 'current' (default) for current conditions, or 'five_day' for a 5-day forecast.
